facts.title: Look Who's Back

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When the modern public mistakes him for a provocative performer, how far can a resurrected dictator rise before anyone notices?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After waking up in present-day Berlin at the site of his former bunker, Adolf Hitler finds himself mistaken for an eccentric comedian and catapulted into sudden media fame.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A biting, medium-paced German comedy balancing sharp laughs with provocative, thoughtful bite.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director David Wnendt mines sharp comic friction from a high-concept premise that uses viral celebrity culture to explore an unthinkable modern return.
